inventory.name: [Nopalcyber][AI SIEM] FortiGate External Source Login Activity

native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.description: Detects FortiGate login events originating from public/external IP addresses, excluding private/internal IP ranges. External authentication attempts against the firewall may indicate internet-based credential attacks, unauthorized access attempts, or compromised accounts being used to access the network perimeter.
native_rule.name: [Nopalcyber][AI SIEM] FortiGate External Source Login Activity

scheduledParams.query:
dataSource.name='FortiGate'
AND event.type='system'
AND unmapped.action='login'
AND unmapped.srcip!=''
AND profile = 'super_admin' 
AND !net_private(unmapped.srcip)
| group count() by unmapped.srcip,profile

native_rule.scopeName: Nopal Support Services Pvt. Ltd., / NopalCyber
native_rule.statusReason: Rule was activated by bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com and will become Active within an hour
